# SafeGuard CCS

SafeGuard CCS is an independent, non-commercial cybersecurity research and education initiative based in Panama.

We study security challenges affecting emerging and growing businesses and translate public cybersecurity frameworks, data protection concepts, and digital hygiene practices into accessible educational resources.

Current research and education topics:
- SME cybersecurity awareness
- Phishing
- Password security
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
- Backups and resilience
- Data protection concepts
- Basic cyber hygiene and security literacy

SafeGuard CCS does not offer paid cybersecurity services.

Website: https://safeguardccs.com/
Contact: https://safeguardccs.com/#contact
Primary location: Panama
